scope: file-level bounded typed semantic review, advisory; not independent release approval

correctness_concern.instructions: Is an evident correctness defect present in this source under the stated scope?

criteria.true: Concrete reachable error, violated invariant or falsely claimed measurement.
criteria.false: No evident defect; unknown runtime support alone does not prove a defect.

security_concern.instructions: Does this source evidently grant model authority, trust false completion, permit cross-tenant leakage, arbitrary execution or unbounded attacker work?

criteria.true: An evident path violates one of those invariants.
criteria.false: The source provides bounded untrusted advice or offline synthetic analysis without that path.

evidence_concern.instructions: Does this source falsely treat mock or synthetic measurements as real trained-model or production qualification?

criteria.false: Mock, scenario or unqualified status is explicit; actual model scripts are merely candidate code.

billing: API responses report tokens, not billing. No billing/top-up/subscription action performed.
